formula.reserveUsd: maxInputTokens * inputUsdPerToken + maxOutputTokens * outputUsdPerToken, per model
formula.requestCap: maxRequests must be >= 72 because this package does not retry, and 36 items x 2 judges = 72 calls
formula.settle: after success, held is reduced from reserve to inputTokens*inputRate + outputTokens*outputRate; provider usd is ignored

corpusSizingFromFrozenInput.recommendedMaxInputTokensReason: run-judge.js estimates input as ceil(chars/4), which can under-count CJK. Until a tokenizer or a tighter bound is in the package, set maxInputTokens to at least the maximum prompt character count of this frozen input, and set budgetUsd to cover 72 reserves at that cap.
corpusSizingFromFrozenInput.recommendedMaxOutputTokens: operator/model JSON verdict size; package will send this value as max_tokens. Not filled here.
